gen_risks.description: ADISA's lack of operational history and implementation experience may lead to execution delays and operational management inefficiencies.
gen_risks.mitigation: Hire experienced PMU staff, provide continuous technical assistance, and establish structured operational procedures under MIPA supervision.
gen_risks.evidence: ADISA has a limited track record of implementation experience, but some members of the project team have relevant experience.

gen_risks.description: High procurement risk at ADISA and PMU could result in procurement delays for critical technical assistance and ICT contracts.
gen_risks.mitigation: Use CFCU for initial PPF procurement, hire dedicated procurement specialists, and require World Bank prior review for key contracts.
gen_risks.evidence: Since ADISA is a newly-created agency and the PMU is not yet fully set up, the procurement risk rating is high.

gen_risks.description: Substantial financial management risk due to lack of prior experience with Bank-funded operations at MIPA and ADISA.
gen_risks.mitigation: Hire qualified financial specialists, establish a Financial Management Manual, purchase accounting software, and conduct annual audits.
gen_risks.evidence: Neither MIPA, nor the recently constituted ADISA have previous experience in implementation of large donor funded operations

gen_risks.description: Physical construction of the Citizen Service Center building may cause localized environmental impacts including dust, noise, and waste.
gen_risks.mitigation: Enforce compliance with a project-specific Environmental Management Plan (EMP) integrated into civil works construction contracts.
gen_risks.evidence: Potential environmental impacts that are associated with new construction include dust and noise, waste generation, material supply, use of machinery

gen_risks.description: Focusing on digital services and urban CSCs risks excluding rural, poor, elderly, and minority citizens with low digital literacy.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish assisted digital outreach points, maintain existing local access points, conduct targeted non-digital communication, and monitor vulnerable user access.
gen_risks.evidence: There is a risk that the focus on state-of-the-art means for service delivery... will diminish access of the poor and vulnerable

gen_risks.description: Complex coordination requirements across more than a dozen agencies could impede business process re-engineering and system integration.
gen_risks.mitigation: Leverage Inter-Ministerial Committees and the Prime Minister's Delivery Unit to enforce agency cooperation and track reform milestones.
gen_risks.evidence: Inter-sectoral reforms, especially those that involve more than a dozen government agencies, necessarily entail complex coordination.

gen_risks.description: Compressed reform timeline and ambitious targets for legal amendments and service re-engineering may lead to schedule slippage.
gen_risks.mitigation: Utilize a phased approach, focus early on quick wins, and link financial disbursements to DLIs spread through 2020.
gen_risks.evidence: The compressed implementation timeline is a potential risk, which is mitigated by the project's span and incentives to deliver up to 2020.

gen_risks.description: Resistance from agency officials and civil servants reluctant to yield front-office authority could delay front-office integration.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement change management programs, conduct internal stakeholder outreach, and secure top-level political mandate via the Prime Minister.
gen_risks.evidence: Ministries, agencies and individual civil servants may not welcome ceding the front office function to CSC. Bureaucratic resistance could stifle efforts

gen_risks.description: Incomplete database digitization and missing personal ID numbers in agency registers hinder database interoperability and service automation.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide TA for database cleanup, standardize data formats, and connect agency databases to the Government Interoperability Platform.
gen_risks.evidence: Property and pension records, for example, are only partially digitized... The National ID number is missing for most records

gen_risks.description: Inaccuracies in administrative tracking data may mask actual processing delays experienced by citizens.
gen_risks.mitigation: Deploy independent third-party verification, periodic citizen surveys, and proactive text-message beneficiary feedback collection.
gen_risks.evidence: The data submitted by the IPRO office on the other hand routinely records that almost all applications are processed within the required six days.

gen_risks.description: Delays in achieving Disbursement Linked Indicators or meeting condition DLI#5 could freeze results-based loan disbursements.
gen_risks.mitigation: Prioritize completion of institutional prerequisites, perform regular DLI tracking, and engage third-party verification early.
gen_risks.evidence: No disbursements under RBF will be made until DLI#5 is achieved... disbursements under RBF are contingent upon achieving DLIs.

gen_risks.description: Inadequate long-term budget provision for software licensing, maintenance, and periodic upgrades could jeopardize e-service operations.
gen_risks.mitigation: Factor ongoing ICT licenses and maintenance costs into long-term fiscal planning using budget savings realized through administrative re-engineering.
gen_risks.evidence: Ongoing operating costs are expected to include licenses and system operation and maintenance... cost of such upgrades should also be appropriately factored

gt_risks.description: Institutional capacity poses challenges to delivering the reform effort, despite very high leadership commitment and fast-paced GoA initiation of reforms.
gt_risks.mitigation: The Project Preparation Facility (PPF) is designed to assist capacity building for the implementing agency; the TA part of the loan continues building capacity to deliver, addressing the most pressing capacity needs.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risks related to the new form of financial instrument used in Albania.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the fiduciary risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Technical design risk, named alongside the fiduciary risk as being addressed by the same TA support (fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU); not separately elaborated beyond this.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the technical design risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risks arising from inter-agency coordination.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by strong emphasis on coordination mechanisms in the design of the operation.

gt_risks.description: Bureaucratic resistance to enhanced transparency and simplification of administrative processes.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated in part through high-level leadership and engagement, and through citizen feedback arrangements that help pinpoint poor performance and corruption.

gt_risks.description: Political cycle risk from elections coming up in 2017, which could disrupt reform continuity and government commitment.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by making early progress in showing results and ensuring a broad constituency of support for the project's objectives and activities among the leadership of participating institutions and service users.
